upgrade.name: Lagoon
upgrade.summary: OP Mainnet activation has not been scheduled. The hardfork registry lists Lagoon as in development, with no superchain-wide activation time.
upgrade.order_summary: No upgrade order between the execution client and op-node is stated for OP Mainnet.
upgrade.warning: The interop prep notice covers OP Sepolia and Unichain Sepolia. It does not name an op-node or op-reth release, and it says OP Mainnet timestamps will be announced separately. A late July 2026 line in that notice is not an activation time. That notice names op-reth as the execution client for interop. op-geth support ended on May 31, 2026.
